name: gizza-ai/password-generator
summary: Generate a strong random password or passphrase.

tool.description: Generate a strong random password or passphrase locally with a cryptographic RNG. mode='password' (default) builds a random string of `length` characters from lowercase (always) plus uppercase/digits/symbols (toggle each); mode='passphrase' joins `words` random words with `separator`. Returns the generated value and its entropy in bits.

length.description: Password length in characters (password mode, default 16).

uppercase.description: Include uppercase letters (password mode). Default true. (Lowercase is always included.)
